items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: I was in the Sam band with Bill Humphrey and Clark Kerr, Magnus Kruster, we all was in the Sam Navy band together.

ctx.x: Were you in the service? Did you get the Gihan Bell for doing that?
I was in the Navy for three and a half years. I was in the Sam band with Bill Humphrey and Clark Kerr, Magnus Kruster, we all was in the Sam Navy band together.
Well I was going to ask, you mentioned these red books, is that the Redback Book of Rags?
